source.name: Goodwood - Qatar Goodwood Festival (official page)
source.note: 'The 2026 Qatar Goodwood Festival presented by Visit Qatar provided five days of world-class racing.' Visit Qatar is also the Presenting Partner on the festival's Partners page (goodwood.com/horseracing/qatar-goodwood-festival/partners/) with logo link to visitqatar.com.

note: 2026 festival ran 28 Jul - 1 Aug (day-by-day guide dates Tuesday 28 July to Saturday 1 August). Individual race titles carry Qatar/Visit Qatar branding: Visit Qatar Sussex Stakes, Qatar Nassau Stakes, King George Qatar Stakes; the Al Shaqab Goodwood Cup is sponsored by Al Shaqab (Qatar Foundation). Original deal term not found. Fee not published.
